component.name: Nix Manager
component.summary: Install Nix and manage its packages

description.p: Nix Manager installs and removes the Nix package manager on a non-NixOS distribution, then manages the packages of your own user profile: search nixpkgs, install a package or an arbitrary flake, upgrade and clean up.

It shows the detected state (Nix version, nix-daemon, install mode, profile path, space used by the /nix store, build sandbox), streams every command into a live journal, and disables its controls while an operation runs.

Installing or removing Nix itself requires the administrator password (pkexec); package operations never do. Packages installed through Nix appear neither in Discover nor in eopkg — their updates go through Nix.
Package selection is now kept across several searches, and the /etc/zoneinfo compatibility link is created automatically when Nix is installed (the Maintenance button is gone).

Packages tab rework: multi-select checkboxes, action buttons left of the tables, Enter key launches the search, relevance-ranked results. Menu entries are regenerated automatically after each install/removal. New button to fix the missing /etc/zoneinfo path required by Heroic and Steam sandboxes.

Installing Nix now detects leftovers from a previous installation (backup files, /nix, nixbld group, systemd units) and offers to clean them before installing, instead of failing with the installer's own error.
Menu integration now rewrites Exec= and Icon= to absolute store paths, so Nix applications launch and show their icon immediately after integration.
Creating the /nix subvolume now handles an existing empty directory and refuses explicitly when /nix already holds data.
Allow unfree packages (discord, steam…) and create or delete a dedicated btrfs subvolume for /nix.
Initial release: Nix state detection, install/uninstall, nixpkgs search, profile package management, flake install, upgrade, garbage collection and desktop integration.
